nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule

segments.oily: Reviewers with an oily T-zone or excess sebum on the nose and chin report the ampoule feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and reduces sebum without adding grease.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and calming, though a few say it feels too light on its own and should be layered with moisturizer or not used on very dry patches.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with an oily T-zone and dry jawline, report improved texture and reduced redness with the product remaining non-irritating.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most numerous group and largely report calming of redness and irritation with no stinging or reaction, though a small number describe increased sensitivity or breakouts after use.
segments.normal: No reviewer describes their skin as simply normal.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 40s with rosacea-prone or aging-sensitive skin report the product calms flare-ups and limits occasional breakouts, with one pairing it with azelaic acid for redness.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers in their late 30s–40s mention using this alongside anti-aging routines and note their skin looks better with age-related sensitivity calmed, though aging itself is not a primary focus of most reviews.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it hydrates and keeps skin moisturized, especially in cold or dry winter conditions, while one reviewer explicitly warns not to use it on very dry skin.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including those with rosacea and eczema, report visible reduction in redness, sometimes within minutes; dissent is minimal but one reviewer says it caused new redness on her chin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers who mention a compromised barrier (from microneedling or general irritation) report the product helped restore and soothe their skin with regular use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for hormonal or chin acne and dark spots report visible fading of spots and dark marks over days to weeks, with one noting reduced dark spot appearance and glossier skin.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report fewer new breakouts and faster healing of existing ones; however, three reviewers report the opposite, describing new breakouts, cystic pimples, or worsened acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the formula controls excess oil and absorbs without leaving a greasy residue.

aspects.libelle: Large bottle, good value for price

extraits.texte: I used the pink poremizing serum and really loved it. I was shocked at how good it was, so when i was having some hormonal breakouts I snagged this. I know this has a lot of postive reviews, but this serum is awful. It feels filmy, and heavier than the pink one. It doesnt absorb fully and my face feels mildly greasy/shiny. When I used it, I developed acne and redness. I stopped using it on my face for about a month. During that month I did use it a few times on chest breakouts (just to use it and not waste it) and I do think it helped calm some redness there. The other day I washed my face (A.M.) and was like, okay let me use this serum alone with nothing else on a clean face-and by the end of the day I had breakouts developing along my chin. And my chin was very red. Which confirmed this product, for me at least, causes irritation and acne. I would recommend 1000% the pink poremizing serum. But i would rip this green tea tree cica one from anyones hands saying spare yourself. Dont buy it.

I'm 31, and have struggled with cystic hormonal acne for over a decade. finally, after 9 years of the same skincare routine, I decided to finally try out new products in hopes I'd get better results. I've been using this product for about 4 days (in combination with a new face wash for 1 day) and my skin is completely clear. when I first started using this, I thought there was no way it'd do anything. it has no smell, and is the consistency of water. it's lightweight and feels like nothing on the skin. I definitely don't think my results are from the new face wash as I've only used it once, and plan to re-purchase this when I run out!

With age 40s type ii rosacea-prone skin, I pair this with azalaic acid to soothe redness and prevent the little bumps and breakouts. It seems to layer well with the AA though the combo can be drying and I moisturize thoroughly as my last step. Even with the rosacea my skin looks better than it ever has. I'm using 2x daily and am slowly working through the bottle, so it's a good amount of toner for the price. Will repurchase.

extraits.titre: Ideal for Sensitive Skin and Redness
extraits.texte: I suffer from eczema and facial redness due to sensitive skin. I've recently heard about Centella Asiatica extract and how it is beneficial to people with acne-prone or sensitive skin like mine. Thankfully I was able to receive a free product from Skin1004 to try it out. The Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule by Skin1004 contains Centella Asiatica extract, Tea Tree water, and pine extract to help sooth reddened and sensitive skin. Please note that this product might not be for everyone as everyone's skin is different. Fortunately, this product works for me and I have not have not had any adverse reactions. I use it before applying my regular Vitamin C serum and moisturizer and have found that it amplifies Vitamin C absorption in helping to brighten skin while preventing some of the redness and sensitivity. The price point is reasonable and I'm a huge fan of Korean skincare that is backed by a mix of experience and science. The consistency is like a toner and the application is straightforward. I like that it comes in a dropper format which allows me to control how much I use. A little goes a long way, I find. The formula is light and watery and primes your skin for serum and moisturizer. I can see myself using this for a long time and highly recommend it to those who suffer from skin sensitives or redness.

I was a bit skeptical at first since I have used another brand's centella toner that didn't do much, but I've been using this every day for the past week and have noticed a huge difference in my skin! I have a very oily T-zone with lots of little bumps/texture, and the amouple has really improved my texture and the redness/discoloration from the acne. I also have quite a bit of dry skin around my jaw and mouth, and it has also helped hydrate the area while not being irritating. The ampoule itself is light and has a very subtle tea-tree oil scent, which smells so good. My skin is smoother and definitely more even now–super impressed with how quickly it started to work. Definitely will purchase after I run out.

extraits.titre: Surprisingly good on my rosacea skin
extraits.texte: I was nervous to try this because I have very sensitive, rosacea skin that has been worse than usual the last few months. I was getting pretty bad flare ups on my t-zone and cheeks with a ton of redness and bumps. I started using this and the flare up started calming down a little more each day. I still have some bumps but compared to what it was it's 85% healed and the redness has gone from tomato to a light pink. I use 6 drops and only use it at night after I take my makeup off and skip applying 2-3 days a week. I don't think it's sticky at all and just feels like I'm putting a little water all over my face. I'm really surprised it hasn't made my rosacea worse because everything else seems to. The smell is also pretty minimal and I don't mind it. I'm not sure if it would be too much if I applied it twice a day and/or used it every single day but as of now I'm happy with the product and don't plan on increasing how often I use it.

I have dry and sensitive skin, and since I don't struggle with a lot of acne, this isn't the most targeted product for my skin type. However, I still enjoy using it because it really soothes my skin. It calms any redness or irritation almost instantly and feels very gentle. The texture is watery and lightweight, so it absorbs fast without leaving any sticky feeling. It also has no strong scent, which is perfect for sensitive skin. Even though it's designed more for oily or acne-prone skin, I love how hydrating and calming it feels on my dry skin.
